clips.title: The story
paras: The Circle of Aquementas is a mysterious ring of upright standing stones positioned along the eastern shoreline of Tanaris, just south of Lost Rigger Cove. It serves as a ritual site where travelers can call forth the elemental spirit Aquementas.

Tucked away along the windswept eastern coast of Tanaris, the Circle of Aquementas sits quietly south of the pirate stronghold at Lost Rigger Cove. Composed of weathered, upright stones arranged in a circular formation, this unusual site hums with elemental energy against the desert shore. It acts as a focus for summoning Aquementas, an elemental entity tied to an ancient artifact. While the surrounding beaches crawl with Southsea brigands and roaming sea creatures, the circle itself remains a solemn pocket of ritual power amidst the dunes.
